scope: One CSS declaration on the existing integration access button; no permission, Java or query change.
defect: The native guide resolver requires a rendered target rectangle. The access button host carried the guide field but display:contents gave it a zero-sized rectangle, omitting the visible main MCP permission control from the tour.
change: The selected native component host uses inline-flex. The button remains in its existing credential row and its nested popup retains its fixed presentation.

qualification.deployment: Template dev HTTP using the selected native component and native guide resolver
qualification.before: API tour contained 9 steps and omitted the main MCP access control.
qualification.after: API tour contains all 10 rendered controls; permission editor, help and manual MCP tours complete.
qualification.visual: Inspected 1440x950 desktop and 390x844 mobile screenshots; no horizontal page overflow.
qualification.limits: The full native MyScoutee browser flow was not replayed for this isolated CSS repair. No load or CPU parity claim is made.
